label: Circular Rating
title: Circular Rating
summary: Use a Circular Rating to show a score out of 100, such as credit health, as a dotted ring with your verdict and one next step.
corePrinciple: A score, what it means, and what to do next.

anatomy.title: A dotted ring, the score, a footer, and a nudge
anatomy.description: Twenty-four dots fill clockwise from 12 o’clock in step with the score. Inside sit a label, the score, and your tier; below come a dated footer and an inline nudge.
blocks: 18 px dots in the ring’s colour; the share lit matches the score.
Grey dots for the rest of the 100.
56 px heavy; the score rounded, out of 100.
16 px bold; your verdict on the score, with a chevron when it opens details.
12 px with an info icon; when the score was updated.
An inline nudge with one button for the next step.

configuration.title: Your words, the dots, and the nudge
configuration.description: You write the label, tier, footer, and nudge; the score comes from the value. Choose how many dots make the ring, and whether the footer icon and the nudge show.
blocks: The score and its footer, when there’s no next step.
Twelve dots: each stands for more of the score. Past about 50 dots they overlap.
With onTierPress the tier row becomes a button with a chevron, such as to open the score’s breakdown.
Modes colour the dots and the nudge together: Secondary is purple.

sizing.title: A fixed 340 px wide
sizing.description: A Circular Rating doesn’t resize. The ring is 320 px with 18 px dots, inside 10 px of padding, and the nudge is 312 px; give it a column at least 340 px wide.
specimen: Pay your card bill in full to raise your score

content.title: Name the score, give a verdict, date it
content.description: Name the score in two or three words, such as “Credit health”. Write the tier as a short verdict that fits one line, start the footer with when it was updated, and give the nudge one action with a verb label, such as “Pay now”.
specimen: Pay your card bill in full to raise your score

inContext.description: The screen passes the score and its tier, and wires both actions: the tier opens the score’s breakdown and Pay now opens the card bill.

sources.title: Use the public Circular Rating contract
sources.description: The guide compares the Figma component with the installed package and its Storybook stories.
blocks: Installed jfs-components is 0.1.78 (16 October build) from the team’s private package repository. Figma has one Circular Rating component with no variants; the package builds it from Circular Progress Bar / Doted and an inline Nudge, and gives both one set of colour modes. Figma shows 26 dots, all lit, on a slightly smaller ring, with a white nudge; the package draws 24 dots lit by the score and colours the nudge with the ring. The nudge button is Figma’s small size by default. Screen readers hear the ring as a progress bar with its value out of 100, named by the label, score, and tier, then the footer as text. The chevron shows only when the tier opens details. Since the #271 fix the default nudge has no close button. With Color Mode Dark the text and grey dots keep their Light colours, so the guide shows Light only.
